name: set_sale_item_unit_cost()
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_sale_item_unit_cost()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
begin
  -- If already provided (rare), keep it. Otherwise snapshot from products.cost_price.
  if new.unit_cost is null then
    select p.cost_price
      into new.unit_cost
    from public.products p
    where p.id = new.product_id;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$
